description: One plan, in `./.dive/plans/` or `~/.config/dive/plans/`, run with `dive plan run` and called by agents and other plans as `plan__<identifier>`.

examples.description: Summarizes the commits merged since a git ref.

solver.query_to_answer: Summarize what changed, grouped by theme.

base.description: The ref to start after, such as the last release tag

examples.name: Weekly changes

description.description: What the plan does. Agents read it when choosing tools.

exemplars.description: Example requests the plan handles, added to its tool description.

finish.description: How the plan ends, and what it returns: `silent`, `output` or `solver`.

oneOf.description: Runs the steps and returns nothing but `{ok, steps_executed}`.

output.description: Returns this map as JSON, each template filled from step results. No model call.

solver.description: A model call writes the answer as prose, returned as `{answer}`.

data.description: What the solver sees, as a map of templates over step results.

query_to_answer.description: What the answer should say, as a template.

system_prompt.description: Extra system prompt for the solver call.

identifier.description: Letters, digits, `_` and `-`. The plan is called as `plan__<identifier>`, and a plan with a built-in plan's identifier replaces it.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for the plan's inputs, validated before any step runs. Steps reference inputs as `{{input.<field>}}`.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the result of an output plan. Its `properties` must match the keys of `finish.output`.

requires_servers.description: MCP servers the steps use. The plan is hidden from the catalog while any of them isn't configured.

name.description: The file name with its extension, such as `snapshot.json`, or a pattern with `*` or `?`, such as `page-*.png`, for several files.

optional.description: When true, a missing file, or a pattern with no match, isn't an error.

files.description: Files the step's tool writes to disk, by name. Dive makes a directory for each call; pass `{{files.<name>.path}}`, or `{{files.<name>.dir}}` for a pattern, to the tool's own output option. After the call each file is stored and listed under the result's `files` with its `name`: `{{<id>.files.<name>.ref}}`, or a list for a pattern.

id.description: Unique across the plan, including steps inside bodies. Later steps read the result as `{{<id>.<field>}}`. Can't be `input`, `item`, `index`, `accumulator` or `length`.

input.description: The tool's input. String values are templates over `input` and earlier results; a control step's input is described on its page.

reasoning.description: Why the step exists, for people reading the plan.

tool_name.description: A catalog tool (`<server>__*`, `user__*`, `builtin__*`, `plan__*`, `agent__*`) or a control step (`exit`, `route`, `filter`, `map`, `reduce`, `agent`, `ask`).

version.description: The file version the document is written in. Omitted means 1; `dive plan migrate` brings a file to the current version.

title: Plan file
